author: TortouseMincer
body:
Hey Moderators :D

I was playing Walls and I saw one of my team-mates had died in lava. (FootballSmasher2 tried to swim in lava)


I thought, they probably jumped in it etc. I started collecting wood then BOOM this guy placed lava on me. I ran and jumped into water to save myself. 
As you can see my hearts are low because he placed lava on me.


I reported him ingame, but I think other moderators were busy with reports.

I then went down to the mine to get some iron, then he did it AGAIN. I took another screenshot but I died. ://



I carried on spectating and then he tried to kill his other team-mate! (I pressed F1 to get a better look but you can still see it is his skin on the right placing it)



The Walls dropped, he PvPed and lost to other players and then started cussing in chat. The user also has one previous infraction for spamming four months ago.


Evidence that he had a lava bucket:

Reported Player: darkdylan2727

Evidence:
http://imgur.com/8qA8xQQ,MYV4Xux,rtSKM1F,KsPwFuz,KSoS6RS,DLj1UWO#5
http://imgur.com/nDeEsvf,uHgMlAN#1

Rules Broken: 
  1. Maintain a casual and positive atmosphere at all times. Inappropriate or aggressive language, regardless if it is directed at someone or not, will not be tolerated. Be respectful of all players. Harassment, bullying, rudeness and excessive swearing is strictly not allowed.
  2. Killing or attempting to kill members of your own team

Thank you for looking at my report, keep up the good work :D


Regards,


TortouseMuncher
